description: Map ClinVar RAD51D missense variants onto the 2.2 A BCDX2 cryo-EM structure and test interface and burial enrichment
code:
import requests, re, time, numpy as np, collections
from scipy import stats
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
H={"User-Agent":"openscientist/1.0 (research)"}
EUT="https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/"

# ---- ClinVar missense residues (with retry) ----
def post_sum(ids):
    for a in range(6):
        try:
            j=requests.post(EUT+"esummary.fcgi",data={"db":"clinvar","id":",".join(ids),"retmode":"json"},headers=H,timeout=60).json()
            if "result" in j: return j["result"]
        except Exception: pass
        time.sleep(2+a)
    return {}
def clinvar(term):
    ids=requests.get(EUT+"esearch.fcgi",params={"db":"clinvar","term":term,"retmode":"json","retmax":1500},headers=H,timeout=60).json()["esearchresult"]["idlist"]
    out=[]
    for i in range(0,len(ids),120):
        res=post_sum(ids[i:i+120]); time.sleep(0.6)
        for k in res.get("uids",[]): out.append(res[k].get("variation_set",[{}])[0].get("variation_name",""))
    return out
AA3={'Ala','Arg','Asn','Asp','Cys','Gln','Glu','Gly','His','Ile','Leu','Lys','Met','Phe','Pro','Ser','Thr','Trp','Tyr','Val'}
def mis(n_):
    o=[]
    for n in n_:
        m=re.search(r"\(p\.([A-Z][a-z]{2})(\d+)([A-Z][a-z]{2})\)",n)
        if m and m.group(1) in AA3 and m.group(3) in AA3 and m.group(1)!=m.group(3): o.append(int(m.group(2)))
    return sorted(set(o))
vus=mis(clinvar('RAD51D[gene] AND "clinsig vus"[Properties]'))
ben=mis(clinvar('RAD51D[gene] AND ("clinsig benign"[Properties] OR "clinsig likely benign"[Properties])'))
print("VUS residues",len(vus),"B/LB residues",len(ben))

# ---- 8OUZ structure ----
txt=requests.get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/8OUZ.pdb",headers=H,timeout=60).text
atoms=collections.defaultdict(list)   # chain -> (resi, element, xyz)
het=[]
for ln in txt.splitlines():
    if ln.startswith(("ATOM","HETATM")):
        el=ln[76:78].strip()
        if el=="H": continue
        ch=ln[21]; resi=int(ln[22:26]); rn=ln[17:20].strip()
        xyz=(float(ln[30:38]),float(ln[38:46]),float(ln[46:54]))
        if ln.startswith("ATOM"): atoms[ch].append((resi,rn,xyz))
        else: het.append((ch,rn,xyz))
print("ligands:",sorted(set((c,r) for c,r,_ in het)))

D={}  # RAD51D residue -> array of atom coords
for resi,rn,xyz in atoms["C"]: D.setdefault(resi,[]).append(xyz)
D={k:np.array(v) for k,v in D.items()}
others={ch:np.array([x for _,_,x in atoms[ch]]) for ch in "ABD"}
names={"A":"RAD51B","B":"RAD51C","D":"XRCC2"}
selfat=np.array([x for _,_,x in atoms["C"]])

def mind(a,B):
    return np.sqrt(((a[:,None,:]-B[None,:,:])**2).sum(-1)).min()

rows={}
for resi,co in D.items():
    d={names[ch]:mind(co,others[ch]) for ch in "ABD"}
    # ATP/ADP ligand distance
    lig=np.array([x for c,r,x in het if r in ("ATP","ADP","AGS","ANP","MG")])
    d["ligand"]=mind(co,lig) if len(lig) else np.nan
    # burial: heavy atoms of the whole complex within 10 A of this residue's centroid
    cen=co.mean(0)[None,:]
    allat=np.vstack([selfat]+[others[c] for c in "ABD"])
    d["cn10"]=int((np.sqrt(((allat-cen)**2).sum(-1))<10).sum())
    rows[resi]=d

modelled=sorted(rows)
CUT=5.0
iface={n:set(r for r in modelled if rows[r][n]<CUT) for n in names.values()}
anyif=set().union(*iface.values())
print(f"\nModelled RAD51D residues: {len(modelled)} ({min(modelled)}-{max(modelled)})")
for n in names.values(): print(f"  interface with {n} (<{CUT} A): {len(iface[n])} residues")
print(f"  any inter-subunit interface: {len(anyif)} residues ({100*len(anyif)/len(modelled):.1f}% of modelled)")
print("  S207 distances:", {k:(round(v,2) if isinstance(v,float) else v) for k,v in rows.get(207,{}).items()})
print("  K113 distances:", {k:(round(v,2) if isinstance(v,float) else v) for k,v in rows.get(113,{}).items()})

# ---- enrichment tests ----
vm=[r for r in vus if r in rows]; bm=[r for r in ben if r in rows]
nv=sum(r in anyif for r in vm); nb=sum(r in anyif for r in bm)
f=len(anyif)/len(modelled)
bt=stats.binomtest(nv,len(vm),f,alternative="greater")
print(f"\nVUS at an inter-subunit interface: {nv}/{len(vm)} = {100*nv/len(vm):.1f}% vs {100*f:.1f}% of modelled residues; binomial p={bt.pvalue:.3f}")
print(f"B/LB at an interface: {nb}/{len(bm)}")
if len(bm)>3:
    orr,pf=stats.fisher_exact([[nv,len(vm)-nv],[nb,len(bm)-nb]]); print(f"  VUS vs B/LB OR={orr:.2f}, Fisher p={pf:.3f}")
cnv=np.array([rows[r]["cn10"] for r in vm]); cnb=np.array([rows[r]["cn10"] for r in bm])
cnall=np.array([rows[r]["cn10"] for r in modelled])
U,p=stats.mannwhitneyu(cnv,cnb,alternative="greater")
print(f"\nBurial (heavy atoms within 10 A of residue centroid): VUS mean {cnv.mean():.1f}, B/LB mean {cnb.mean():.1f}, all {cnall.mean():.1f}")
print(f"  VUS vs B/LB Mann-Whitney U={U:.0f}, one-sided p={p:.4f}; rank-biserial r={1-2*U/(len(cnv)*len(cnb)):.3f}")
U2,p2=stats.mannwhitneyu(cnv,cnall,alternative="greater")
print(f"  VUS vs all modelled: U={U2:.0f}, p={p2:.3f}")

# ---- figure ----
fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12,4.8))
x=np.array(modelled); y=np.array([min(rows[r][n] for n in names.values()) for r in modelled])
ax[0].plot(x,y,color="#999999",lw=1)
ax[0].axhline(CUT,ls="--",color="k",lw=.9)
ax[0].text(300,CUT+0.6,f"{CUT} A contact cut-off",ha="right",fontsize=8)
vx=[r for r in vm]; ax[0].scatter(vx,[min(rows[r][n] for n in names.values()) for r in vx],s=12,color="#dd8452",label=f"missense VUS (n={len(vm)})",zorder=3)
ax[0].scatter(bm,[min(rows[r][n] for n in names.values()) for r in bm],marker="v",s=55,color="#55a868",label=f"benign / likely benign (n={len(bm)})",zorder=4)
ax[0].scatter([207],[min(rows[207][n] for n in names.values())],marker="*",s=220,color="#c44e52",label="S207, the one P/LP missense",zorder=5)
ax[0].set_xlabel("RAD51D residue (chain C of PDB 8OUZ)"); ax[0].set_ylabel("distance to nearest\nRAD51B / RAD51C / XRCC2 atom (A)")
ax[0].set_ylim(0,32); ax[0].legend(fontsize=8,frameon=False)
ax[0].set_title("A. S207 sits in the RAD51D-XRCC2 contact surface",fontsize=11)
parts=ax[1].violinplot([cnall,cnv,cnb],showmedians=True)
ax[1].set_xticks([1,2,3]); ax[1].set_xticklabels([f"all modelled\n(n={len(modelled)})",f"missense VUS\n(n={len(vm)})",f"benign/LB\n(n={len(bm)})"])
ax[1].set_ylabel("heavy atoms within 10 A (burial)")
ax[1].set_title(f"B. Benign missense sit on the surface (Mann-Whitney p = {p:.3f})",fontsize=11)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
